result: PARTIAL: colors, eight clicks and switch/release passed; cursor overlay failed.
notes: First round sampled an occluding local window. No clicks or keys were sent in that round; its failed evidence is preserved.

Second round uses PrintWindow on the owned native surface. Both window sizes have correct portrait colors. Eight clicks received exactly one down/up on the portrait screen, maximum error 2 source pixels, primary received zero clicks.
The injector now targets integer viewport pixels with width/height minus one; the product coordinate code and three-pixel assertion were unchanged.
Four cursor samples confirm visible remote OS cursor with changing position, but displayed cursor ROI has zero changed pixels. Overlay acceptance failed.
An independent switch test after the cursor assertion held Ctrl, switched primary, verified read-only mode and release of Ctrl/mouse.
First collection of second-round files failed while fixture still held output open; collection succeeded after fixture exit and all files were hash verified.
Both rounds restored service, released keys, removed temporary display and cleaned bounded staged tasks; local drivers exited 0.
